segments.text: 5 Till at the laſt Daniel came before me, whoſe name was Beltſazar, according to the name of my God, which hath the ſpirite of the holy Gods in him, and before him I told the dreame, ſaying:

6 O Beltſazar chief of the enchaunters, becauſe I know that the ſpirite of the holy Gods is in thee, and no ſecrete troubleth thee, tell me the viſions of my dreame that I haue ſene, and the interpretation therof.
